report_name: AI-Assisted Attack on Spanish Rail Network Exfiltrated 500GB of Data

threat_actors.name: Unattributed AI-Assisted Threat Actor
threat_actors.description: An unidentified threat actor who conducted a sophisticated, AI-assisted cyberattack against Spain's rail infrastructure operators, Adif and Renfe, in September 2026, leveraging commercial AI models to accelerate reconnaissance and data exfiltration.
threat_actors.goals: Data exfiltration of sensitive employee and customer data from Spanish rail networks.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Attackers gained initial access by exploiting an unspecified vulnerability in Adif's public-facing web and application infrastructure.

attack_patterns.name: Active Scanning
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor conducted multi-week reconnaissance, including active scanning, against the network perimeters of Adif and Renfe.

attack_patterns.name: Brute Force
attack_patterns.description: The attackers performed brute-force attempts against the network perimeters of Adif and Renfe during the reconnaissance phase.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: Attackers exfiltrated 500 GB of data, including customer portal databases and employee records, over the command and control channel, with the process accelerated by AI tools.

attack_patterns.name: Generative AI
attack_patterns.description: The attackers used commercial generative AI models from Anthropic and OpenAI to accelerate various stages of the attack, including reconnaissance and data exfiltration.

attack_patterns.name: Process Discovery
attack_patterns.description: AI-powered tools were used for rapid internal network and database mapping after the initial breach.

attack_patterns.name: Vulnerability Scanning
attack_patterns.description: The use of AI likely automated tasks such as vulnerability scanning of the internal network.

tools.name: Anthropic AI Model
tools.description: A commercial AI model from Anthropic was used by the attackers to accelerate reconnaissance and data exfiltration.

tools.name: OpenAI AI Model
tools.description: A commercial AI model from OpenAI was used by the attackers to accelerate reconnaissance and data exfiltration.

tools.name: curl
tools.description: The curl utility was suggested as a potential tool used by attackers for on-system interaction with external AI services for attack automation.

tools.name: wget
tools.description: The wget utility was suggested as a potential tool used by attackers for on-system interaction with external AI services for attack automation.

vulnerabilities.name: Unspecified Web Server Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: An unspecified vulnerability in Adif's public-facing web servers was exploited for initial access into the network.

identities.name: Adif
identities.description: Spain's national rail infrastructure manager, which was the initial point of compromise in the cyberattack.

identities.name: Renfe
identities.description: Spain's national rail operator, which was compromised after attackers pivoted from Adif's network, resulting in a 500GB data breach.

infrastructure.name: Adif Public-Facing Web Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: The public-facing web and application infrastructure of Adif, which was compromised and used as a pivot point into Renfe's network.

indicators.name: Outbound Connection to Commercial AI APIs
indicators.pattern:
title: Outbound Connection to Commercial AI APIs
id: 2b8a1c3d-f9e0-4b1a-8c7d-6e5f4d3c2b1a
status: experimental
description: Detects outbound DNS queries to known commercial AI service APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic), which could indicate AI-assisted attack activity as described in the Adif/Renfe breach.
references:
  - https://industrialcyber.co/transport/shieldworkz-finds-adif-web-infrastructure-served-as-entry-point-for-renfe-compromise-in-ai-assisted-cyber-breach/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-30
tags:
  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.aml.t0016.002
level: medium
logsource:
  category: dns_query
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName|contains:
      - 'api.openai.com'
      - 'api.anthropic.com'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects DNS queries to commercial AI APIs, which could be indicative of an AI-assisted attack.

indicators.name: CLI Interaction with External AI APIs
indicators.pattern:
title: CLI Interaction with External AI APIs
id: 9e8d7c6b-5a4f-4e3d-2c1b-0a9f8e7d6c5b
status: experimental
description: Detects command-line usage of curl or wget with patterns suggesting API key usage for commercial AI services like OpenAI or Anthropic.
references:
  - https://industrialcyber.co/transport/shieldworkz-finds-adif-web-infrastructure-served-as-entry-point-for-renfe-compromise-in-ai-assisted-cyber-breach/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-30
tags:
  - attack.t1059
  - attack.execution
  - attack.aml.t0016.002
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/curl'
      - '/wget'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
  selection_api:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'api.openai.com'
      - 'api.anthropic.com'
  selection_key:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Authorization: Bearer'
      - 'x-api-key:'
  condition: all of selection_*
indicators.description: Detects command-line usage of curl/wget with API keys for AI services, a potential indicator of attack automation.

indicators.name: Anomalous Process Spawned by Web Server
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Process Spawned by Web Server
id: 8d7c6b5a-4f3e-4d2c-1b0a-9f8e7d6c5b4a
status: experimental
description: Detects suspicious processes (like shells or network utilities) being spawned by a web server process, which can indicate post-exploitation activity after a web vulnerability is compromised.
references:
  - https://industrialcyber.co/transport/shieldworkz-finds-adif-web-infrastructure-served-as-entry-point-for-renfe-compromise-in-ai-assisted-cyber-breach/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-30
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.initial_access
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\w3wp.exe'
      - '\httpd.exe'
      - '\apache2.exe'
      - '\nginx.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\sh.exe'
      - '\bash.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\whoami.exe'
  condition: all of selection_*
indicators.description: Detects web server processes spawning shells or other tools, indicating potential post-exploitation activity.
